hypotheses.justification: Split on whether buCutScalar κ z ≥ 0. In that case use the existing proof. Otherwise the left side is nonpositive by Real.sqrt_nonneg, while the right side is nonnegative by hM and vec3EuclideanNorm_nonneg. Zero cutoff and zero gradients are covered.
Recover it from hderiv at (0 : Fin 3): 0 ≤ |spatialPartial (buCutScalar κ) 0 z| ≤ M. Then the existing proof applies unchanged. Fin 3 is nonempty, and this also covers zero derivatives and M = 0.
